messages:
ana: short RFC follow-up: propose we "slice" the inference hotpath into micro-surfaces (router, preproc, model-exec, postproc) with strict, minimal contracts. goal: make each slice independently deployable so we can pay down tech debt without big cutovers. asking for sequencing and safety checks.
tomas: +1. must define a contract test per slice (input schema, idempotency, header passthrough). otherwise we get silent mismatches.
rebecca: suggest a compatibility window per-slice: run contract-tests in CI, then enable slice in dry-run mode for 48h, then canary 2 tenants, then ramp. keep old path for 14d post-cutover.
harry: ops ask: add an error-budget tag and chargeback metric per slice. platform won't be happy absorbing noisy slices. also add a per-tenant opt-out flag.
nana: (typo fix) ana: noted :facepalm: — we'll include per-tenant feature flags. also planning: automated weave test that replays 10k recorded requests to catch semantic regressions.
tomas: observability: ensure trace-id + slice-id in spans. add a small dashboard that shows per-slice p99 and contract-fail count.
rebecca: rollback strategy: flip routing at the API-gateway to old path if contract-fail > 0.3% for 30m or p99 regresses beyond SLO. add a manual kill-switch too.
eng-bot: deploy note: "slice-decomposition-v1" pushed to staging at 2026-04-10T18:30Z. contract test job added to CI.
harry: small policy: any slice touching customer data needs an owner and a documented retention policy before cutover. no exceptions.
nana: okay will add owners to the rollout doc and schedule a two-sprint cleanup to remove dead branches after deprecation. can people react :thumbsup: if they agree to the sequence?
tomas: :thumbsup:
rebecca: :thumbsup:
harry: :thumbsup:
nana: thanks everyone  I'll open the epic and tag owners; drop further comments here.
